name: Bali e-VOA
fullName: Indonesia e-VOA (visa on arrival) for Bali: photo and passport page
covers: Bali, Jakarta and the rest of Indonesia
intro: Most visitors to Bali apply online for Indonesia's electronic visa on arrival (e-VOA), called the Visitor Visa on the official site. The form asks for two uploads: a passport-style photo and the photo page of your passport. Each must be a JPG or PNG of 200 KB or less.

documents.label: Photo
notes: JPG or PNG, 200 KB or less (the official limit).
The site doesn't set a pixel size, so we make a standard 35 × 45 mm passport-style photo.
Use a recent colour photo on a plain light background, facing the camera, with no sunglasses or hat.

documents.label: Passport photo page
notes: The whole photo page of your passport, JPG or PNG, 200 KB or less (the official limit).
Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months from the day you arrive.
Every letter must be readable, including the two lines of letters and arrows at the bottom of the page.

source.label: the official Indonesian e-Visa website (Directorate General of Immigration)

facts.label: Who can use it
facts.value: Passport holders of about 90 countries, including India, the US, the UK and Australia. Check that yours is on the list on the official site.

facts.label: Cost
facts.value: IDR 500,000 per person, paid online by Visa, Mastercard or JCB card.

facts.label: Stay
facts.value: 30 days, single entry. It can be extended once, for another 30 days, at an immigration office in Indonesia.

facts.label: When to apply
facts.value: At least 48 hours before you fly. Every traveller, including babies and children, needs their own visa.

steps: Go to evisa.imigrasi.go.id, choose Apply, then Register. Open the email it sends and activate your account within one hour.
Log in, choose Apply again and pick the Visitor Visa (e-VOA). Enter your arrival date and where you'll stay in Indonesia.
Upload the photo and passport page you made on this page. Both must be 200 KB or less.
Check that every detail matches your passport exactly. Mistakes can't be refunded.
Pay within 120 minutes of reaching the payment page, or you'll have to start a new request.
Download the visa from your account. Keep a copy on your phone and a printed copy.
beforeYouFly: Fill in the free All Indonesia arrival card at allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id in the 3 days before you land, and keep the QR code.
Pay Bali's tourist levy (IDR 150,000) on the official Love Bali site, lovebali.baliprov.go.id.
Carry a return or onward ticket and a passport with at least 2 blank pages.

sources.label: Wego: Indonesia visa for Indians, updated May 2026 (extension, arrival card and Bali levy)

seo.metaTitle: Bali (Indonesia) e-VOA photo under 200 KB, and how to apply
seo.description: Make the photo and passport page for Indonesia's e-VOA under 200 KB, then follow clear steps to get your Bali visa on the official site. Free, nothing is uploaded.
seo.lede: Make both uploads Indonesia's e-VOA asks for, each under 200 KB, then follow the steps below to apply on the official site.

faqs.q: What size photo does the Bali e-VOA need?
faqs.a: The official site sets a file limit of 200 KB (JPG or PNG) but no pixel size. A standard 35 × 45 mm passport-style photo on a plain light background works; this page makes one under 200 KB.

faqs.q: Why won't my passport page upload?
faqs.a: Usually because the file is over 200 KB. Phone photos are several MB. Make it here and it comes out under the limit, with the text still readable.

faqs.q: Is the e-VOA the same as the visa on arrival?
faqs.a: Yes. It's the same visa, applied for online before you fly, so you can skip the visa queue at the airport. Indonesia's site calls it the Visitor Visa.
